name: Ram bap
summary: Ram bắp is a thin rice-paper roll of young corn, fried crisp; some cooks add pork and shrimp, others only scallion and a little flour. The corn tastes sweet and nutty inside the crisp wrapper, dipped in a sweet-sour fish sauce.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls it crisp, rich, and nutty from the corn. ZaloPay calls the corn sweet and the wrapper crisp, with a diluted sweet-sour fish sauce.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: pork, shrimp, and young corn, fried crisp. Roll it with herbs, rice noodles, and thin rice paper, and dip it in mixed fish sauce. The printed sale unit is 500 g.
ZaloPay: young corn, scallion, a little flour, and thin rice paper, fried. Eat it with herbs and cucumber, dipped in diluted sweet-sour fish sauce.
The culture office lists ram bắp among the folk dishes at the Don An Phú festival.
where: The festival ground south of cầu Cổ Lũy, thôn Phú Thọ, when Lễ hội Don An Phú is on.
seoTitle: Ram bap — young-corn rolls in Quang Ngai
seoDescription: Ram bắp, crisp rice-paper rolls of sweet young corn, dipped in sweet-sour fish sauce. 80,000 VND for 500 g.
